description: Testing, inspection, certification, assurance, verification, audit and conformity assessment industries.

entity_extensions.service: Testing, laboratory analysis, inspection, statutory inspection, certification, product conformity assessment, management-system audit, supplier audit, verification, validation, calibration, asset integrity, technical assurance, environmental monitoring or training.
entity_extensions.asset: Industrial plant, factory, building, infrastructure, vessel, aircraft, vehicle, pipeline, power asset, mine, laboratory, product, equipment, supply chain or worksite.
entity_extensions.standard: A technical standard, management-system standard, regulation, directive, code, testing protocol or conformity-assessment framework such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001 or ISO/IEC 17025.
entity_extensions.certification: A certificate, accreditation, inspection approval, type approval, conformity mark or certification programme.
entity_extensions.customer_segment: Manufacturers, importers, exporters, infrastructure operators, energy companies, construction firms, food producers, retailers, government agencies or supply-chain operators.
